label: Food Styling
description: How the food scene is styled, plated and propped.

items.name: rustic-board
items.text: styled on a scarred wooden board, scattered flour, herb sprigs and a worn-handled knife laid casually off-axis

items.name: fine-dining-void
items.text: centered on an oversize plate in a dark void, a single spotlight carving the food out of blackness

items.name: overhead-spread
items.text: a full overhead table spread, dishes almost touching, hands reaching in from the edges mid-serve

items.name: marble-minimal
items.text: on veined marble with one rumpled linen napkin and vintage silver cutlery, everything else cleared away

items.name: steam-backlit
items.text: backlit so every wisp of steam glows against shadow, rim light tracing the food's silhouette

items.name: ingredient-scatter
items.text: surrounded by an artful scatter of its raw ingredients, whole spices and torn leaves leading the eye inward

items.name: market-context
items.text: styled amid a bustling market stall, produce crates and hanging scales softly out of focus behind

items.name: picnic-blanket
items.text: laid out on a checked blanket in dappled orchard light, wicker basket open, jam jar glinting

items.name: neon-diner
items.text: on a chrome diner counter washed in neon signage glow, the napkin-dispenser steel doubling every color

items.name: action-crumbs
items.text: caught in action, crumbs and drips suspended mid-fall, the bite or break happening right now

items.name: nouvelle-plating
items.text: plated in nouvelle-cuisine geometry — one perfect quenelle, a comma of sauce, acres of white porcelain negative space

items.name: nordic-plating
items.text: New Nordic plating on rough stoneware — foraged leaves, edible flowers and a dust of dried berry over muted food

items.name: family-style
items.text: served family-style in dented well-loved pans set straight on the table, serving spoons standing, trivets scorched

items.name: izakaya-counter
items.text: on a crowded izakaya counter, small plates overlapping, a beer glass and chopstick rest crowding the frame edge

items.name: hard-light-pop
items.text: hard-light editorial styling, deep graphic shadows thrown across a saturated color-pop seamless

items.name: kaiseki-course
items.text: one kaiseki course on black lacquer, three precise elements and a seasonal leaf, negative space doing half the plating, a single rough ceramic accent against the gloss

items.name: bistro-tablecloth
items.text: on a bistro's paper-over-linen tablecloth, a carafe of house red and stemless glasses crowding in, the handwritten bill tucked under the salt cellar

items.name: patisserie-case
items.text: styled as the star shelf of a patisserie vitrine, neighboring éclairs and glazed tartes defocused through the curved glass, hand-lettered price cards on picks
